content.title: 时态复习·一般/进行/完成(现在与过去)速查
content.intro: 时态看两件事:时间(现在/过去)和状态(经常做/正在做/已完成)。判断口诀:先找句中的时间标志词,再据它定时态——标志词决定唯一答案。

headers: 用法 / 时间标志词 / 例句
rows: 经常/反复:every day, usually, always, often, regularly — Mum jogs every morning.
此刻正在:right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!, now — Look! Dad is growing a beard now.
持续/影响到现在:since, for, already, yet, just, ever, never, recently, so far — Dad has changed since we last met.
过去确定时间:yesterday, ago, last…, in 2005, when I was young — Grandma called us yesterday.
过去的过去:by the time, before, …had taken then — By the time we arrived, she had cooked dinner.
过去某刻正在(作背景):while, when(被打断), as — While Mum was cooking, I set the table.

specialRules.mark: I have just finished the guest list.

specialRules.rule: yesterday/ago/last…/in+年份 → 一般过去时(不用完成时)
specialRules.mark: We had a holiday last summer.(× have had)

specialRules.rule: by the time + 过去句 → 主句用过去完成时
specialRules.mark: By the time he came, we had left.

specialRules.rule: while / when 被打断 → 背景动作用过去进行时
specialRules.mark: I was tidying my room when I found the photo.

why: 时态本质是'什么时候+什么状态';时间标志词把范围锁死,所以一旦看到 since 就排除一般过去时、看到 yesterday 就排除现在完成时,答案自然唯一。
gaokaoPoints: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时(since/for/already vs yesterday/ago)是语法填空与改错高频点。
过去完成时强调'过去的过去';while/when 引导的背景常用过去进行时;family/记叙文里大量出现。

examVsReal.exam: I have just finished my homework.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: I just finished my homework.(美式口语)
examVsReal.note: 考试里 just + 现在完成;美式口语常用一般过去 + just。

examVsReal.exam: By the time he arrived, we had eaten.(考试)
examVsReal.real: By the time he arrived, we'd already eaten.
examVsReal.note: 口语多用缩写 'd 并加 already,意思相同。
